hindi: “शम, सन्धि, समाधान” — एक अर्थ।
english: “Peace (śama), peace (sandhi), settlement (samādhi)” — [this is] one meaning.
notes: Three terms declared synonyms. śama = peace (6.2) and bare sandhi = peace (7.3/7.4), so English shows the Sanskrit words in brackets to keep them apart; Hindi keeps शम and सन्धि. samādhi: 'settlement' (literally 'putting together'), medium confidence; Hindi uses समाधान because समाधि reads as trance. The iti is carried by the quotation marks.
lines_deva: शमः सन्धिः समाधिर् इत्य् एको ऽर्थः

hindi: राजाओं का विश्वास को प्राप्त होना — “शम, सन्धि, समाधान”।
english: The kings’ coming to trust — “peace (śama), peace (sandhi), settlement (samādhi).”
notes: Definition: the verb is not stated, so the line is rendered as a dash. upagama = approach, reaching; whose trust is not said (mutual trust of kings is the natural sense). The iti is carried by the quotation marks.
lines_deva: राज्ञां विश्वास.उपगमः शमः सन्धिः समाधिर् इति
lines_iast: rājñāṃ viśvāsa.upagamaḥ śamaḥ sandhiḥ samādhir iti

hindi: “सत्य या शपथ अस्थिर सन्धि है; प्रतिभू या प्रतिग्रह स्थिर है,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: “Truth or an oath [is] an unstable peace; a surety or a pratigraha [is] a stable [one],” say the teachers.
notes: calaḥ literally 'moving'. pratigraha is left untranslated; unit 11 defines it as the taking of relatives and chiefs (hostage-taking). The teachers' view is rejected in unit 4.
lines_deva: "सत्यं शपथो वा चलः सन्धिः, प्रतिभूः प्रतिग्रहो वा स्थावरः" इत्य् आचार्याः
lines_iast: "satyaṃ śapatho vā calaḥ sandhiḥ, pratibhūḥ pratigraho vā sthāvaraḥ" ity ācāryāḥ

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “No,” says Kautilya.
notes: Formula of the glossary (12.1). Answers the teachers' view of unit 3.
lines_deva: न-इति कौटिल्यः

hindi: सत्य या शपथ परलोक में और यहाँ स्थिर सन्धि है; प्रतिभू या प्रतिग्रह यहाँ के प्रयोजन वाला ही, बल की अपेक्षा रखने वाला है।
english: Truth or an oath [is] a stable peace hereafter and here; a surety or a pratigraha, having only here as its purpose, [is] dependent on strength.
notes: paratra: literally 'in the other place'; 'hereafter / next world' is the usual sense (medium). iha-artha eva: eva belongs to the compound ('here alone as purpose'). bala: 'force' here; glossary 8.5 has bala = army, which would give 'dependent on an army' (alternative). Correction: bala is rendered 'strength' (बल); 'army' (glossary 8.5) is the alternative.
lines_deva: सत्यं शपथो वा परत्र-इह च स्थावरः सन्धिः, इह.अर्थ एव प्रतिभूः प्रतिग्रहो वा बल.अपेक्षः
lines_iast: satyaṃ śapatho vā paratra-iha ca sthāvaraḥ sandhiḥ, iha.artha eva pratibhūḥ pratigraho vā bala.apekṣaḥ

hindi: “हम संहित हैं,” सत्य-सन्ध पहले के राजाओं ने सत्य से सन्धि की।
english: “We are allied,” the former kings, true in agreement, made peace by truth.
notes: The iti closes the quoted words and is carried by the quotation marks. satya-sandha = 'whose agreement is truth' (true to his word). sandadhire: 'joined, concluded a treaty', medium. Correction: sandadhire = 'made peace' (Book 7 bare sandhi = peace), not 'concluded a treaty'.
lines_deva: "संहिताः स्मः" इति सत्य.सन्धाः पूर्वे राजानः सत्येन सन्दधिरे
lines_iast: "saṃhitāḥ smaḥ" iti satya.sandhāḥ pūrve rājānaḥ satyena sandadhire

words.gloss: fire, water, furrow, rampart, clod, elephant’s shoulder, horse’s back, chariot-seat
weapon, gem, seed, perfume, taste, gold, money

hindi: उसका अतिक्रमण होने पर शपथ से अग्नि, जल, कूँड़, प्राकार, ढेला, हाथी का कन्धा, घोड़े की पीठ, रथ का आसन, शस्त्र, रत्न, बीज, गन्ध, रस, सोना, धन को छुआ — “जो शपथ का अतिक्रमण करे, उसे ये मारें और छोड़ दें।”
english: In transgression of that, [they] touched with an oath fire, water, furrow, rampart, clod, elephant’s shoulder, horse’s back, chariot-seat, weapon, gem, seed, perfume, taste, gold and money: “May these slay, and abandon, him who would transgress the oath.”

text_flags.why: possible: the '-' is the e-text's line-end continuation mark left in the middle of one line, with a stray space; the compound runs on

notes: The two compounds are one long dvandva interrupted by a line-end mark ('upastha.-'), so the members are taken together; whether hasti-skandha, aśva-pṛṣṭa, ratha-upastha are single items or pairs is not marked by the dots. sītā = furrow (literal); upastha = 'lap, seat', rendered 'chariot-seat' (medium); rasa = taste (alternatives juice, poison); suvarṇa = gold and hiraṇya = money (glossary 4.1, 5.2). ālebhire: ā-√labh 'take hold of, touch'. The subject 'they' (the former kings of unit 6) is bracketed. The iti closes the quoted curse.
lines_deva: तस्य-अतिक्रमे शपथेन अग्न्य्.उदक.सीता.प्राकार.लोष्ट.हस्ति.स्कन्ध.अश्व.पृष्ट.रथ.उपस्थ.- शस्त्र.रत्न.बीज.गन्ध.रस.सुवर्ण.हिरण्यान्य् आलेभिरे "हन्युर् एतानि त्यजेयुश् च-एनं यः शपथम् अतिक्रामेत्" इति
lines_iast: tasya-atikrame śapathena agny.udaka.sītā.prākāra.loṣṭa.hasti.skandha.aśva.pṛṣṭa.ratha.upastha.- śastra.ratna.bīja.gandha.rasa.suvarṇa.hiraṇyāny ālebhire "hanyur etāni tyajeyuś ca-enaṃ yaḥ śapatham atikrāmet" iti

hindi: शपथ का अतिक्रमण होने पर महानों, तपस्वियों या मुख्यों का प्रातिभाव्य-बन्ध प्रतिभू है।
english: In transgression of the oath, the binding of suretyship of the great, of ascetics or of chiefs [is] the surety.
notes: Defines pratibhū: the suretyship-binding undertaken by the great, ascetics or chiefs, which takes effect if the oath is broken. mahatām is taken as 'of the great' (persons); bandha kept literal 'binding' (glossary 3.x leaves bandha untranslated in other contexts).
lines_deva: शपथ.अतिक्रमे महतां तपस्विनां मुख्यानां वा प्रातिभाव्य.बन्धः प्रतिभूः
lines_iast: śapatha.atikrame mahatāṃ tapasvināṃ mukhyānāṃ vā prātibhāvya.bandhaḥ pratibhūḥ

hindi: उसमें जो दूसरे को रोकने में समर्थ प्रतिभुओं को लेता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: In that, he who takes sureties capable of restraining the other, he outwits.
notes: para = the other (party), singular; not rendered 'enemy' (glossary 9.2). avagraha = restraint. No object of atisandhatte is stated.
lines_deva: तस्मिन् यः पर.अवग्रह.समर्थान् प्रतिभुवो गृह्णाति, सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: tasmin yaḥ para.avagraha.samarthān pratibhuvo gṛhṇāti, so 'tisandhatte

hindi: विपरीत छल लिया जाता है।
english: The opposite is outwitted.
notes: viparīta = the one who does the opposite (here: takes sureties not capable of restraint); no noun is stated.
lines_deva: विपरीतो ऽतिसन्धीयते

hindi: बन्धुओं और मुख्यों का लेना प्रतिग्रह है।
english: The taking of relatives and chiefs [is] pratigraha.
notes: Defines pratigraha. pragraha here 'taking, holding' (not the 'favouring' of glossary 8.3). bandhu-mukhya taken as dvandva 'relatives and chiefs'; alternative 'chief relatives'.
lines_deva: बन्धु.मुख्य.प्रग्रहः प्रतिग्रहः

hindi: उसमें जो दूष्य अमात्य या दूष्य सन्तान को देता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: In that, he who gives a treasonable minister or a treasonable offspring, he outwits.
notes: dūṣya = the treasonable (glossary 6.2). 'In that' = in the pratigraha.
lines_deva: तस्मिन् यो दूष्य.अमात्यं दूष्य.अपत्यं वा ददाति, सो ऽतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: tasmin yo dūṣya.amātyaṃ dūṣya.apatyaṃ vā dadāti, so 'tisandhatte

hindi: विपरीत छल लिया जाता है।
english: The opposite is outwitted.
notes: As unit 10.
lines_deva: विपरीतो ऽतिसन्धीयते

words.gloss: of one trusting in the taking of a pratigraha

hindi: क्योंकि प्रतिग्रह के लेने पर विश्वास करने वाले के छिद्रों पर दूसरा निरपेक्ष प्रहार करता है।
english: For the other, regardless, strikes at the weak points of one who trusts in the taking of a pratigraha.
notes: chidra = weak point (glossary 13.4). nirapekṣa = 'without regard, unconcerned' (not caring for the pledge).
lines_deva: प्रतिग्रह.ग्रहण.विश्वस्तस्य हि परश् छिद्रेषु निरपेक्षः प्रहरति
lines_iast: pratigraha.grahaṇa.viśvastasya hi paraś chidreṣu nirapekṣaḥ praharati

words.gloss: in the giving of a daughter and a son

hindi: किन्तु सन्तान-समाधान में, कन्या और पुत्र के दान में, कन्या देने वाला परन्तु छल लेता है।
english: But in an offspring-settlement, in the giving of a daughter and a son, [one] giving a daughter, however, outwits.
notes: apatya-samādhi: a settlement in which offspring are given (literally 'offspring-settlement'); samādhi as in unit 1. kanyā = girl, 'daughter' in running English (glossary 3.5). The two tu are rendered 'but' and 'however'. The dvandva kanyā-putra could also mean 'daughter or son'.
lines_deva: अपत्य.समाधौ तु कन्या.पुत्र.दाने ददत् तु कन्याम् अतिसन्धत्ते
lines_iast: apatya.samādhau tu kanyā.putra.dāne dadat tu kanyām atisandhatte

words.gloss: editors’ mark of doubt (not a word)

hindi: क्योंकि कन्या उत्तराधिकारी नहीं है, दूसरों के ही प्रयोजन के लिए है, और आक्लेश्या (?)।
english: For a daughter [is] a non-heir, [is] for the purpose of others only, and ākleśyā (?).

text_flags.why: possible: the editors themselves doubt the word; 'a-kleśyā' (not to be troubled) is an alternative reading, but the printed form may be original

notes: ākleśyā is marked '(?)' by the editors and is left untranslated. If read a-kleśyā it would mean 'not to be troubled'; as printed (ā-√kliś gerundive) it would mean 'to be troubled', which gives the opposite sense, so no meaning is fixed. 'eva' attaches to pareṣām ('of others alone').
lines_deva: कन्या ह्य् अदायादा परेषाम् एव-अर्थाय-आक्लेश्या (?) च
lines_iast: kanyā hy adāyādā pareṣām eva-arthāya-ākleśyā (?) ca

hindi: पुत्र विपरीत है।
english: The son [is] the opposite.
notes: Contrasts with the daughter of unit 16 (the text itself says only 'opposite').
lines_deva: विपरीतः पुत्रः

hindi: दो पुत्रों में भी जो कुलीन, प्राज्ञ, शूर, अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित या एक-पुत्र को देता है, वह छल लिया जाता है।
english: Even among two sons, he who gives the high-born, the wise, the brave, the one trained in arms, or an only son, he is outwitted.
notes: putrayoḥ api: 'even of/among two sons' (case doubtful). eka-putra: here the son who is an only son (see unit 31); in unit 27 the same word describes the man with one son.
lines_deva: पुत्रयोर् अपि यो जात्यं प्राज्ञं शूरं कृत.अस्त्रम् एक.पुत्रं वा ददाति सो ऽतिसन्धीयते
lines_iast: putrayor api yo jātyaṃ prājñaṃ śūraṃ kṛta.astram eka.putraṃ vā dadāti so 'tisandhīyate

hindi: विपरीत छल लेता है।
english: The opposite outwits.
notes: As unit 10, active.
lines_deva: विपरीतो ऽतिसन्धत्ते

words.gloss: because of the lost line of heirs
from loss of the power of counsel
from loss of the power of energy
than the one trained in arms
from loss of the excellence of what is to be struck

hindi: क्योंकि कुलीन से अकुलीन बन्धक रखने के लिए श्रेयस्कर है, दायाद-सन्तान के लुप्त होने से; प्राज्ञ से अप्राज्ञ, मन्त्रशक्ति के लोप से; शूर से अशूर, उत्साहशक्ति के लोप से; अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित से अस्त्र-अप्रशिक्षित, प्रहार किए जाने योग्य की सम्पत् के लोप से; एक-पुत्र से अनेक-पुत्र, निरपेक्षता से।
english: For one of low birth is better to pledge than one of high birth, because of the lost line of heirs; [one] not wise [better] than a wise one, from the loss of the power of counsel; [one] not brave [better] than a brave one, from the loss of the power of energy; [one] untrained in arms [better] than one trained in arms, from the loss of the excellence of what is to be struck; [one] not an only son [better] than an only son, because of indifference.
notes: ādhātum: 'to pledge' (glossary 3.12 ādhāna = pledging); the one who is given over. lupta-dāyāda-santāna-tva: abstract noun 'state of having the line of heirs lost'. prahartavya-sampad: gerundive 'to be struck'; probably 'capacity to strike' (alternative), kept literal, medium-low. aneka-putra literally 'having many sons' (as in unit 27); here taken as the opposite of eka-putra. śreyān is not repeated in the later clauses; supplied in brackets (English). Wherever the list uses 'than', an ablative.
lines_deva: जात्याद् अजात्यो हि लुप्त.दायाद.सन्तानत्वाद् आधातुं श्रेयान्, प्राज्ञाद् अप्राज्ञो मन्त्र.शक्ति.लोपात्, शूराद् अशूर उत्साह.शक्ति.लोपात्, कृत.अस्त्राद् अकृत.अस्त्रः प्रहर्तव्य.सम्पल्.लोपात्, एक.पुत्राद् अनेक.पुत्रो निरपेक्षत्वात्
lines_iast: jātyād ajātyo hi lupta.dāyāda.santānatvād ādhātuṃ śreyān, prājñād aprājño mantra.śakti.lopāt, śūrād aśūra utsāha.śakti.lopāt, kṛta.astrād akṛta.astraḥ prahartavya.sampal.lopāt, eka.putrād aneka.putro nirapekṣatvāt

words.gloss: of the high-born and the wise

hindi: कुलीन और प्राज्ञ में, कुलीन अप्राज्ञ का ऐश्वर्य-प्रकृति अनुसरण करती है; प्राज्ञ अकुलीन का मन्त्र-अधिकार अनुसरण करता है।
english: Between the high-born and the wise, the nature of lordship follows the high-born who is not wise; the authority of counsel [follows] the wise who is not high-born.
notes: aiśvarya-prakṛti = nature (svabhāva) of lordship, glossary 8.2. anuvartate, 'follows, goes with'; the sense (the lordly nature / the right to counsel attaches to each) is medium. anuvartate is not repeated in the second clause.
lines_deva: जात्य.प्राज्ञयोर् जात्यम् अप्राज्ञम् ऐश्वर्य.प्रकृतिर् अनुवर्तते, प्राज्ञम् अजात्यं मन्त्र.अधिकारः
lines_iast: jātya.prājñayor jātyam aprājñam aiśvarya.prakṛtir anuvartate, prājñam ajātyaṃ mantra.adhikāraḥ

hindi: मन्त्र-अधिकार में भी वृद्धों के सम्पर्क से कुलीन प्राज्ञ को छल लेता है।
english: Even in the authority of counsel, the high-born outwits the wise through connection with elders.
notes: vṛddha = elders (persons), not the 'grown' of glossary 7.4; samyoga = connection (glossary 4.7).
lines_deva: मन्त्र.अधिकारे ऽपि वृद्ध.सम्योगाज् जात्यः प्राज्ञम् अतिसन्धत्ते

words.gloss: of the wise and the brave

hindi: प्राज्ञ और शूर में, मति और कर्मों का योग प्राज्ञ अशूर का अनुसरण करता है; विक्रम-अधिकार शूर अप्राज्ञ का अनुसरण करता है।
english: Between the wise and the brave, the connection of thought and actions follows the wise who is not brave; the authority of valour [follows] the brave who is not wise.
notes: yoga = joining, application (not the 'acquisition' of 6.2); mati-karmaṇām taken as a dvandva 'of thought and actions' (medium). karma = action. anuvartate not repeated in the second clause. Correction: yoga = connection, as 7.9; 'application' is the alternative.
lines_deva: प्राज्ञ.शूरयोः प्राज्ञम् अशूरं मति.कर्मणां योगो ऽनुवर्तते, शूरम् अप्राज्ञं विक्रम.अधिकारः
lines_iast: prājña.śūrayoḥ prājñam aśūraṃ mati.karmaṇāṃ yogo 'nuvartate, śūram aprājñaṃ vikrama.adhikāraḥ

hindi: विक्रम-अधिकार में भी हाथी को शिकारी की तरह प्राज्ञ शूर को छल लेता है।
english: Even in the authority of valour, the wise outwits the brave, like a hunter [outwitting] an elephant.

text_flags.why: possible stray final ś (likely the first letter of the next unit, which begins with śūra-)

notes: The final ś of the printed atisandhatteś looks like a stray letter (perhaps the start of the next unit's śūra...).
lines_deva: विक्रम.अधिकारे ऽपि हस्तिनम् इव लुब्धकः प्राज्ञः शूरम् अतिसन्धत्तेश्
lines_iast: vikrama.adhikāre 'pi hastinam iva lubdhakaḥ prājñaḥ śūram atisandhatteś

words.gloss: of the brave and the one trained in arms

hindi: शूर और अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित में, विक्रम का निश्चय शूर अस्त्र-अप्रशिक्षित का अनुसरण करता है; लक्ष्य-लाभ का अधिकार अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित अशूर का अनुसरण करता है।
english: Between the brave and the one trained in arms, the resolve of valour follows the brave one untrained in arms; the authority of acquiring the target [follows] the one trained in arms who is not brave.
notes: vyavasāya = resolve, determination (Hindi निश्चय, not व्यवसाय). lambha = acquisition (glossary 13.5); lakṣya = target, mark.
lines_deva: शूर.कृत.अस्त्रयोः शूरम् अकृत.अस्त्रं विक्रम.व्यवसायो ऽनुवर्तते, कृत.अस्त्रम् अशूरं लक्ष्य.लम्भ.अधिकारः
lines_iast: śūra.kṛta.astrayoḥ śūram akṛta.astraṃ vikrama.vyavasāyo 'nuvartate, kṛta.astram aśūraṃ lakṣya.lambha.adhikāraḥ

words.gloss: in the authority of acquiring the target

hindi: लक्ष्य-लाभ के अधिकार में भी स्थिरता, समझ और हानि के अभाव से शूर अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित को छल लेता है।
english: Even in the authority of acquiring the target, the brave outwits the one trained in arms through steadiness, understanding and non-loss.
notes: pratipatti = understanding, readiness (medium); asammoṣa literally 'non-stealing / non-loss', possibly 'freedom from confusion' (alternative); low-medium.
lines_deva: लक्ष्य.लम्भ.अधिकारे ऽपि स्थैर्य.प्रतिपत्त्य्.असम्मोषैः शूरः कृत.अस्त्रम् अतिसन्धत्ते

words.gloss: of the one with many sons and the one with one son

hindi: बहुत पुत्रों वाले और एक पुत्र वाले में, बहुत पुत्रों वाला एक को देकर, शेष से टिका हुआ सन्धि का अतिक्रमण करता है, दूसरा नहीं।
english: Of the one with many sons and the one with one son, the one with many sons, having given one, propped by the rest, transgresses the peace; not the other.
notes: pratiṣṭabdha (prati-√stambh): 'propped, supported'; alternative 'made firm, obstinate'. 'ekam' = one (son), no noun stated.
lines_deva: बह्व्.एक.पुत्रयोर् बहु.पुत्र एकं दत्त्वा शेष.प्रतिष्टब्धः सन्धिम् अतिक्रामति, न-इतरः
lines_iast: bahv.eka.putrayor bahu.putra ekaṃ dattvā śeṣa.pratiṣṭabdhaḥ sandhim atikrāmati, na-itaraḥ

words.gloss: in the giving of a son and all one’s property

hindi: यदि पुत्र और सर्वस्व के दान में सन्धि है, पुत्र-फल से विशेष है।
english: If the peace [is] in the giving of a son and all one’s property, [there is] a distinction from the fruit of sons.
notes: sarva-sva = one's entire property. Whether 'son' and 'all property' are two alternatives ('or') is not clear; rendered by the dvandva 'and'. putra-phala 'fruit of sons' is literal; the sense (benefit expected from the son) is medium-low.
lines_deva: पुत्र.सर्व.स्व.दाने सन्धिश् चेत् पुत्र.फलतो विशेषः

hindi: दो समान फल वालों में, समर्थ प्रजनन से विशेष है।
english: Between two of equal fruit, [there is] a distinction from capable procreation.
notes: Continues unit 28. prajanana = procreation, begetting.
lines_deva: सम.फलयोः शक्त.प्रजननतो विशेषः

hindi: समर्थ प्रजनन वाले दो में भी उपस्थित प्रजनन से विशेष है।
english: Even between two of capable procreation, [there is] a distinction from procreation at hand.
notes: upasthita = present, at hand, ready; the exact sense (offspring already present) is not fixed.
lines_deva: शक्त.प्रजननयोर् अप्य् उपस्थित.प्रजननतो विशेषः

words.gloss: one whose birth of sons is lost

hindi: किन्तु शक्तिमान् एक-पुत्र में, लुप्त पुत्र-उत्पत्ति वाला अपने को बन्धक रखे, और एक-पुत्र को नहीं।
english: But in the case of a capable only son, [one] whose birth of sons is lost should pledge himself, and not an only son.
notes: The closing iti has no opening quotation in the unit; it is not rendered (it probably closes the whole discussion of units 28-31). ca-eka-putram: 'and not an only son'. lupta-putra-utpatti: one who can no longer beget sons.
lines_deva: शक्तिमत्य् एक.पुत्रे तु लुप्त.पुत्र.उत्पत्तिर् आत्मानम् आदध्यात्, न च-एक.पुत्रम् इति
lines_iast: śaktimaty eka.putre tu lupta.putra.utpattir ātmānam ādadhyāt, na ca-eka.putram iti

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pass. pres. part. abhi-ud-√ci

hindi: संचित किया जाता हुआ समाधि-मोक्ष करवाए।
english: Being heaped up, [he] should have the release of the samādhi done.
notes: Subject not stated. abhi-ud-√ci is taken literally ('heaped up, raised'); the sense is uncertain. samādhi is obscure here (literally 'putting together, settlement, concentration'; a pledge or engagement is possible), so the word is kept, not interpreted. mokṣa = release (glossary 3.3). The unit is very short and its connection with the neighbouring units is not clear.
lines_deva: अभ्युच्चीयमानः समाधि.मोक्षं कारयेत्

words.gloss: in the guise of artisans and craftsmen

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. ātm. √kṛ

words.gloss: having caused to be dug near

hindi: कुमार के निकटवर्ती गुप्तचर, कारु और शिल्पी के वेश वाले, कर्म करते हुए, रात में सुरंग से निकट खुदवाकर कुमार को हर ले जाएँ।
english: Secret agents near the prince, in the guise of artisans and craftsmen, doing works, having had [a way] dug near by a tunnel at night, should carry off the prince.
notes: upakhānayitvā: upa-√khan caus., 'having caused to be dug near'; what is dug (a tunnel) is not stated beyond suruṅgayā. karmāṇi = works (glossary 3.14/7.2 line); the agents are only 'doing works' as part of the disguise. kumāra = prince.
lines_deva: कुमार.आसन्नाः सत्त्रिणः कारु.शिल्पि.व्यञ्जनाः कर्माणि कुर्वाणाः सुरुङ्गया रात्राव् उपखानयित्वा कुमारम् अपहरेयुः
lines_iast: kumāra.āsannāḥ sattriṇaḥ kāru.śilpi.vyañjanāḥ karmāṇi kurvāṇāḥ suruṅgayā rātrāv upakhānayitvā kumāram apahareyuḥ

words.gloss: actors, dancers, singers, players of instruments, those living by speech, kuśīlavas, plavakas and saubhikas

hindi: अथवा नट, नर्तक, गायक, वादक, वाणी से जीविका चलाने वाले, कुशीलव, प्लवक, सौभिक, पहले से भेजे हुए, दूसरे की सेवा में उपस्थित हों।
english: Or actors, dancers, singers, players of instruments, those who live by speech, kuśīlavas, plavakas and saubhikas, previously dispatched, should wait upon the other.
notes: saubhikā is saubhikāḥ with regular visarga loss before v. kuśīlava, plavaka and saubhika are kept as terms (kuśīlava per glossary 5.3; plavaka literally 'leaper', saubhika obscure). naṭa = actor, vādaka = one who plays (instruments). param = 'the other' (the other king), not 'enemy' (glossary 9.2). The compound is read as one dvandva; vāg-jīvana = those whose livelihood is speech.
lines_deva: नटनर्तक.गायन.वादक.वाग्.जीवन.कुशीलव.प्लवक.सौभिका वा पूर्व.प्रणिहिताः परम् उपतिष्ठेरन्

hindi: वे कुमार की एक के बाद एक सेवा में उपस्थित हों।
english: They should wait upon the prince in succession.
notes: paraṃ.parayā is the regular paramparayā ('in succession, one after another'), printed with the compound dot. The '-' marks an unsandhied join with upatiṣṭheran.
lines_deva: ते कुमारं परं.परया-उपतिष्ठेरन्

words.gloss: entries, stayings and exits of unfixed time
words.gram: n. acc. pl., dvandva with bahuvrīhi prefix

hindi: उनके अनियत काल वाले प्रवेश, स्थान, निर्गमन स्थापित करे।
english: [He] should establish their entries, stayings and exits at unfixed times.
notes: sthāna = staying (glossary 7.4), not 'place'. aniyata-kāla is taken with all three of praveśa, sthāna, nirgamana; it could also qualify only praveśa. Subject not stated. sthāpayet may also be 'should arrange'.
lines_deva: तेषाम् अनियत.काल.प्रवेश.स्थान.निर्गमनानि स्थापयेत्

hindi: तब अथवा उस वेश वाला रात में प्रस्थान करे।
english: Then, or having that guise, [he] should set out at night.
notes: Subject not stated; tad-vyañjana = 'having that guise' (of the persons of the preceding unit, or of the prince); the antecedent of tad is uncertain.
lines_deva: ततस् तद्.व्यञ्जनो वा रात्रौ प्रतिष्ठेत

hindi: इससे रूपाजीवाओं और पत्नी के वेश वाले गुप्तचरों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, courtesans and agents in the guise of wives are explained.
notes: Formula 'tena X vyākhyātāḥ' (glossary 4.1). rūpa-ājīvā = courtesan (glossary 10.1). bhāryā-vyañjana: 'agents' is supplied from the X-vyañjana convention of the glossary.
lines_deva: तेन रूप.आजीवा भार्या.व्यञ्जनाश् च व्याख्याताः

hindi: अथवा उनके वाद्य, माल, फेला को लेकर निकल जाए।
english: Or, having taken their musical instruments, wares and phelā, [he] should go out.
notes: phelā is kept untranslated (glossary 13.2). The compound is read as a dvandva (as in unit 40, where phelā is a list member); 'phelā of the musical instruments and wares' is also possible. bhāṇḍa = wares (glossary 4.6); tūrya = musical instrument.
lines_deva: तेषां वा तूर्य.भाण्ड.फेलां गृहीत्वा निर्गच्छेत्

words.gloss: cooks, ārālikas, bath-attendants, rubbers, bed-spreaders, kalpakas, adorners (compound continues)
words.gram: m. inst. pl. stem, dvandva (continues in next token)

words.gloss: articles, clothes, wares, phelā, beds, seats, uses

hindi: रसोइयों, आरालिकों, स्नान कराने वालों, रगड़ने वालों, बिछौना बिछाने वालों, कल्पकों, प्रसाधकों, जल-सेवकों द्वारा अथवा द्रव्य, वस्त्र, माल, फेला, शयन, आसन, उपभोगों द्वारा बाहर ले जाया जाए।
english: [He] should be carried out by cooks, ārālikas, bath-attendants, rubbers, bed-spreaders, kalpakas, adorners and water-attendants, or by articles, clothes, wares, phelā, beds, seats and uses.

text_flags.why: possible: the line-end continuation mark '-' and the following space belong to the print line break; the compound simply continues. Not a Sanskrit error.

notes: The first dvandva continues across the continuation mark into udaka-paricārakaiḥ (one compound, split by the e-text). sūda = cook (glossary 5.1); ārālika kept (glossary 5.1); phelā kept (glossary 13.2). snāpaka (one who bathes [others]), saṃvāhaka (one who rubs; usually 'shampooer, masseur'), āstaraka (one who spreads), kalpaka (one who arranges; usually 'barber') and prasādhaka (one who adorns) are rendered literally; the usual specialised senses are not applied. The second instrumental series is taken as means ('by'); 'with' is possible. sambhoga = use; Hindi उपभोग. Subject (the prince or the king) not stated. āsana here = seat, not the policy āsana.
lines_deva: सूद.आरालिक.स्नापक.संवाहक.आस्तरक.कल्पक.प्रसाधक.- उदक.परिचारकैर् वा द्रव्य.वस्त्र.भाण्ड.फेला.शयन.आसन.सम्भोगैर् निर्ह्रियेत

words.gloss: in the disguise of an attendant
by the mouth of a tunnel

hindi: अथवा परिचारक के छद्म से कुछ लेकर अरूप समय में निकल जाए, सुरंग के मुख से या रात्रि-उपहार से।
english: Or, in the disguise of an attendant, having taken something at a formless time, [he] should go out, by the mouth of a tunnel or by a night-offering.
notes: paricārakac.chadmanā is paricāraka-chadmanā with regular cch doubling. arūpa-velā is taken literally ('formless time'); the sense (an unusual or dark hour) is uncertain. niśā-upahāra, literally 'night-offering', is obscure; the comma is the e-text's.
lines_deva: परिचारकच्.छद्मना वा किञ्चिद् अरूप.वेलायाम् आदाय निर्गच्छेत्, सुरुङ्गा.मुखेन वा निशा.उपहारेण
lines_iast: paricārakac.chadmanā vā kiñcid arūpa.velāyām ādāya nirgacchet, suruṅgā.mukhena vā niśā.upahāreṇa

hindi: अथवा जलाशय में वारुण योग का आश्रय ले।
english: Or, in a reservoir of water, [he] should adopt the Varuna contrivance.
notes: yoga = contrivance (glossary 12.4/13.2); the nature of the vāruṇa yoga is not stated and is not guessed. āśaya = receptacle, hence reservoir.
lines_deva: तोय.आशये वा वारुणं योगम् आतिष्ठेत्

words.gloss: by dealing in cooked food and fruit

hindi: अथवा व्यापारी के वेश वाले गुप्तचर पके अन्न और फल के व्यवहार से रक्षकों में विष परोसवाएँ।
english: Or agents in the guise of traders, by dealing in cooked food and fruit, should cause poison to be served among the guards.
notes: rasa = poison (glossary 12.5); vaidehaka = trader (glossary 3.4/8.4). upa-√car caus. is rendered literally 'cause to be served'; the sense 'administer' is implied. vyañjanā is vyañjanāḥ with regular visarga loss before v.
lines_deva: वैदेहक.व्यञ्जना वा पक्व.अन्न.फल.व्यवहारेण-आरक्षिषु रसम् उपचारयेयुः

words.gloss: for the purpose of offerings to deities, śrāddha, prahavaṇa
words.gram: n. acc. sg. used adverbially, tat-puruṣa

words.gloss: by the inciting of the guards

hindi: देवताओं के उपहार, श्राद्ध, प्रहवण के निमित्त रक्षकों में मदन-योग से युक्त अन्न और पान या विष लगाकर चला जाए, अथवा रक्षकों को उभारने से।
english: For the purpose of offerings to deities, śrāddha and prahavaṇa, having applied among the guards food and drink joined with a madana compound, or poison, [he] should go away; or by inciting the guards.
notes: prahavaṇa is kept untranslated (glossary). madana kept as a name, its effect not stated; yoga in madana-yoga = compound (glossary 14.1/14.4). protsāhana = inciting (pra-ut-√sah caus.; glossary 13.1 utsāhayati = rouse). The final 'ārakṣaka-protsāhanena vā' is an elliptical alternative: the verb is not repeated.
lines_deva: दैवत.उपहार.श्राद्ध.प्रहवण.निमित्तम् आरक्षिषु मदन.योग.युक्तम् अन्न.पानं रसं वा प्रयुज्य-अपगच्छेत्, आरक्षक.प्रोत्साहनेन वा
lines_iast: daivata.upahāra.śrāddha.prahavaṇa.nimittam ārakṣiṣu madana.yoga.yuktam anna.pānaṃ rasaṃ vā prayujya-apagacchet, ārakṣaka.protsāhanena vā

words.gloss: in the guise of townsmen, kuśīlavas, physicians, cake-dealers

hindi: अथवा नगरवासी, कुशीलव, चिकित्सक, आपूपिक के वेश वाले गुप्तचर रात में समृद्ध घरों को प्रज्वलित करें, या रक्षकों के।
english: Or agents in the guise of townsmen, kuśīlavas, physicians and cake-dealers should set ablaze at night the prosperous houses, or [those] of the guards.
notes: nāgaraka = townsman (cf. paura, glossary 8.1); āpūpika = dealer in cakes (āpūpa), literal. kuśīlava kept (glossary 5.3). 'ārakṣiṇāṃ vā' leaves gṛhāṇi unstated; the genitive could also be read with the whole phrase ('of the prosperous among the guards'?), which is unlikely.
lines_deva: नागरक.कुशीलव.चिकित्सक.आपूपिक.व्यञ्जना वा रात्रौ समृद्ध.गृहाण्य् आदीपयेयुः आरक्षिणां वा
lines_iast: nāgaraka.kuśīlava.cikitsaka.āpūpika.vyañjanā vā rātrau samṛddha.gṛhāṇy ādīpayeyuḥ ārakṣiṇāṃ vā

hindi: अथवा व्यापारी के वेश वाले गुप्तचर पण्य-संस्था को प्रज्वलित करें।
english: Or agents in the guise of traders should set ablaze the establishment of wares.
notes: paṇya = wares (glossary 5.3). saṃsthā is rendered literally 'establishment' (a market or warehouse is meant); Hindi keeps पण्य-संस्था since संस्था alone suggests an organisation.
lines_deva: वैदेहक.व्यञ्जना वा पण्य.संस्थाम् आदीपयेयुः

hindi: अथवा दूसरा शरीर रखकर अपने घर को प्रज्वलित करे, पीछा किए जाने के भय से।
english: Or, having placed another body, [he] should set his own house ablaze, from fear of pursuit.
notes: anupāta is rendered 'pursuit' (literally 'falling after'). Subject not stated.
lines_deva: अन्यद् वा शरीरं निक्षिप्य स्व.गृहम् आदीपयेद् अनुपात.भयात्
lines_iast: anyad vā śarīraṃ nikṣipya sva.gṛham ādīpayed anupāta.bhayāt

words.gloss: by cuttings of joints, excavations and tunnels

hindi: तब जोड़ काटने, खुदाई, सुरंगों से चला जाए।
english: Then [he] should go away by cuttings of joints, excavations and tunnels.
notes: sandhic.cheda is sandhi-cheda with regular cch doubling. sandhi here = joint, junction (cf. glossary 5.3 sandhi-divasa), not treaty or peace. khāta = something dug (excavation); a moat is also possible.
lines_deva: ततः सन्धिच्.छेद.खात.सुरुङ्गाभिर् अपगच्छेत्

words.gloss: in the guise of [a bearer of] a load of glass, pots, wares

hindi: अथवा काच, घड़े, माल के बोझ के वेश वाला रात में प्रस्थान करे।
english: Or [he], in the guise of [a bearer of] a load of glass, pots and wares, should set out at night.
notes: kāca = glass (the carrying-pole sense is also possible, then 'load on a carrying-pole'). kumbha = pot. bhāṇḍa = wares (glossary 4.6). Subject not stated.
lines_deva: काच.कुम्भ.भाण्ड.भार.व्यञ्जनो वा रात्रौ प्रतिष्ठेत

words.gloss: of the shaven-headed and the matted-haired
of the guises of making [oneself] misshapen and diseased, and of forest-goers

hindi: मुण्डित और जटाधारियों के प्रवासनों में प्रविष्ट हुआ, या रात में उस वेश वाला प्रस्थान करे, या कुरूप और रोगी करने, वनचर के छद्मों में से किसी एक से।
english: Or, having entered the pravāsanas of the shaven-headed and the matted-haired, [he] in that guise should set out at night; or by any one of the guises of making [oneself] misshapen and diseased, and of forest-goers.
notes: pravāsana is obscure: 'lodgings' (from pra-√vas) is a guess; elsewhere in the glossary pravāsana = banishment or sending away, which does not fit well. Kept as a term. muṇḍa and jaṭila are adjectives used as nouns; 'ascetics' is not added. The long compound is read as virūpa-karaṇa / vyādhi-karaṇa / araṇya-cara members of chadman; the division is uncertain (araṇya-cara = forest-goer, glossary 4.10). araṇya.carac.chadmanām: cch doubling. The final vā is rendered at the start of the Hindi clause.
lines_deva: मुण्ड.जटिलानां प्रवासनान्य् अनुप्रविष्टो वा रात्रौ तद्.व्यञ्जनः प्रतिष्ठेत, विरूप.व्याधि.करण.अरण्य.चरच्.छद्मनाम् अन्यतमेन वा
lines_iast: muṇḍa.jaṭilānāṃ pravāsanāny anupraviṣṭo vā rātrau tad.vyañjanaḥ pratiṣṭheta, virūpa.vyādhi.karaṇa.araṇya.carac.chadmanām anyatamena vā

words.gloss: in the guise of the deceased

hindi: अथवा मृतक के वेश वाला गुप्तचरों द्वारा बाहर ले जाया जाए।
english: Or, in the guise of the deceased, [he] should be carried out by secret agents.
notes: preta = the deceased (glossary 5.3). gūḍha = secret agent when a person (glossary 12.5).
lines_deva: प्रेत.व्यञ्जनो वा गूढैर् निर्ह्रियेत

words.gloss: in the dress of a woman

hindi: अथवा स्त्री के वेश से मृतक के पीछे जाए।
english: Or [he] should follow the deceased in the dress of a woman.
notes: Subject not stated; preta = the deceased (glossary 5.3).
lines_deva: प्रेतं वा स्त्री.वेषेण-अनुगच्छेत्

hindi: और वनचर के वेश वाले गुप्तचर इसे, एक ओर जाते हुए को, दूसरी ओर बताएँ।
english: And agents in the guise of forest-goers should point him, going in one direction, [as going] in another.
notes: vana-cara = forest-goer (cf. araṇya-cara, glossary 4.10). apa-√diś = point out (glossary 7.2). The two anyataḥ are read as 'in one direction ... in another'; the supplied '[as going]' is implied.
lines_deva: वन.चर.व्यञ्जनाश् च-एनम् अन्यतो यान्तम् अन्यतो ऽपदिशेयुः

hindi: तब दूसरी ओर जाए।
english: Then [he] should go in another direction.
notes: Subject not stated.
lines_deva: ततो ऽन्यतो गच्छेत्

hindi: अथवा चक्रचरों के शकट-बाड़ों से चला जाए।
english: Or [he] should go away by the cart-enclosures of the cakra-wanderers.
notes: cakra-cara = cakra-wanderer (glossary 4.4), sense not guessed. vāṭa = enclosure; śakaṭa = cart. Subject not stated.
lines_deva: चक्र.चराणां वा शकट.वाटैर् अपगच्छेत्

hindi: और पीछा निकट होने पर या सत्त्र को ग्रहण करे।
english: And when pursuit is near, or [he] should take hold of a sattra.
notes: sattra kept untranslated (glossary 7.5; 'hiding-place' of 8.5 is not certain here). The vā links this as an alternative to the means in the preceding units; the English follows the Sanskrit order. loc. absolute: pursuit being near.
lines_deva: आसन्ने च-अनुपाते सत्त्रं वा गृह्णीयात्

words.gloss: in the absence of a sattra

hindi: सत्त्र के अभाव में धन या विष-मिली खाद्य-वस्तु दोनों ओर के मार्ग पर फेंक दे।
english: In the absence of a sattra, [he] should cast out money, or a kind of food mixed with poison, on the road on both sides.
notes: hiraṇya = money (glossary 5.2); rasa-viddha = mixed with poison (glossary 12.5). ubhayataḥ-panthānam is taken as 'the road on both sides / in both directions'; the exact sense is uncertain. rasa-viddhaṃ could also qualify hiraṇyam ('money or [something] mixed with poison').
lines_deva: सत्त्र.अभावे हिरण्यं रस.विद्धं वा भक्ष्य.जातम् उभयतः.पन्थानम् उत्सृजेत्
lines_iast: sattra.abhāve hiraṇyaṃ rasa.viddhaṃ vā bhakṣya.jātam ubhayataḥ.panthānam utsṛjet

hindi: तब दूसरी ओर चला जाए।
english: Then [he] should go away in another direction.
notes: Subject not stated.
lines_deva: ततो ऽन्यतो ऽपगच्छेत्

hindi: अथवा पकड़ा गया साम आदि से पीछा किए जाने को छल ले, या विष-मिले मार्ग-भोजन से।
english: Or, seized, [he] should outwit the pursuit by conciliation and the rest, or by food on the road mixed with poison.
notes: atisandadhyāt = should outwit (glossary 5.1/9.1); sāma-ādi = conciliation and the rest (glossary 8.5). anupāta may mean the pursuit or the pursuers; Hindi takes it as persons. pathy.adana = pathi-adana, literally 'eating on the road' (food for the journey). rasa = poison.
lines_deva: गृहीतो वा साम.आदिभिर् अनुपातम् अतिसन्दध्यात्, रस.विद्धेन वा पथ्य्.अदनेन
lines_iast: gṛhīto vā sāma.ādibhir anupātam atisandadhyāt, rasa.viddhena vā pathy.adanena

hindi: अथवा वारुण योग, अग्नि, दाहों में दूसरा शरीर रखकर शत्रु पर आरोप लगाए: “मेरा पुत्र तुम्हारे द्वारा मारा गया।”
english: Or, in Varuna contrivances, fires [and] burnings, having placed another body, [he] should charge the enemy: “My son has been killed by you.”
notes: The locative compound is read as a dvandva (vāruṇa-yoga, agni, dāha); other divisions (e.g. 'burnings by fire and the Varuna contrivance') are possible. abhi-√yuj is rendered 'charge' (accuse); 'attack' is also possible. The closing iti of the quotation is carried by the quotation marks only (glossary 13.1). Subject not stated.
lines_deva: वारुण.योग.अग्नि.दाहेषु वा शरीरम् अन्यद् आधाय शत्रुम् अभियुञ्जीत "पुत्रो मे त्वया हतः" इति
lines_iast: vāruṇa.yoga.agni.dāheṣu vā śarīram anyad ādhāya śatrum abhiyuñjīta "putro me tvayā hataḥ" iti

words.gloss: with a concealed weapon taken up

hindi: अथवा छिपाया हुआ शस्त्र धारण किए हुए रात में रक्षकों में आगे बढ़कर शीघ्र पातों से, छिपाकर भेजे हुओं के साथ, पीछे हट जाए।
english: Or, with a concealed weapon taken up, having advanced at night among the guards, [he] should withdraw by swift fallings, together with [those] dispatched in secret.
notes: upāttac.channa = upātta-channa (cch doubling). rakṣin = guard. śīghra-pāta (literally 'swift fall, swift flight') is obscure and kept literal; it may qualify gūḍha-praṇihitaiḥ ('with swift-moving secretly dispatched men'). gūḍha-praṇihita = dispatched in secret, i.e. agents (cf. gūḍha-puruṣa, glossary 12.4). Subject not stated.
lines_deva: उपात्तच्.छन्न.शस्त्रो वा रात्रौ विक्रम्य रक्षिषु
शीघ्र.पातैर् अपसरेद् गूढ.प्रणिहितैः सह
